attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ymgG`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls; the model names it in 99% and hesitates 0.07 bits. Then columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 11 to 89% of calls.

**The first fork columns are the most hesitant.** Column 2, `ymgF`, is the most hesitant of the window at 1.74 bits, in a region of plasticity in 89% of calls, and the fewest named, 61%. Column 3, `pdeG`, follows at 0.98 bits, in a region of plasticity in 89% of calls, and column 12, protein YmgK, at 1.06 bits, in a region of plasticity in 80%.

**Branches run beside the most carried families.** Columns 1 to 11 carry a second branch of 11 families, `ymgI` to `ycgN`, including `minE` to `minC`, [[cell division site selection]], carried by 10 to 11% of chromosomes. Columns 13 to 20 carry `umuD` to `dadX`, [[error-prone DNA repair]], and columns 49 to 62 carry `chaA` to `ychJ`, [[nitrate response and transport]], each branch carried by 11%.

**Later forks carry persistent families.** Columns 22 to 25 carry `ldcA` to `ymgE`, columns 27 to 31 carry `treA` to `dhaR`, columns 33 to 46 carry `ychF` to `ldrB`, and columns 64 to 68 carry `rssA` to `tdk`, each branch carried by 11% of chromosomes. The `potB` to `potD` columns and the `lolE` to `lolC` columns sit in fork and variable columns, [[spermidine/putrescine transport]] and [[lipoprotein release]].

**The window ends in the `flg` genes.** Columns 64 to 79 run through `flgL` to `flgN`, [[flagellar basal body assembly]], in fork and variable columns, ending at `flgN` in 40% of chromosomes. Across the window the model names 90% of genes at 0.50 bits; inside a region of plasticity it names 76% at 1.24 bits, against 97% at 0.14 bits outside.

label: ymgG
facts:
WINDOW: the ymgG window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ymgG, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,528 to 2,607 from dnaA. Read in 524 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ymgG once); 41,920 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.50 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,355 calls, named 97%, 0.13 bits; shell 14,001 calls, named 78%, 1.09 bits; cloud 564 calls, named 17%, 3.84 bits. Outside an RGP 28,340 calls, named 97%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 13,580 calls, named 76%, 1.24 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 69 fork, 10 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.24 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (76% against 97%); 13,580 of the 41,920 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 2 (ymgF) 1.74 bits, RGP 89%; column 12 ("protein YmgK") 1.06 bits, RGP 80%; column 3 (pdeG) 0.98 bits, RGP 89%. The 13 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.77 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 90%, 0.44 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 11-89%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: ymgG "YMGG-like glycine zipper-containing…". named 99%; 0.07 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 11-89%. named 61-97% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 2, named 61%, 1.74 bits.
   a second branch of 11 families through columns 1-11, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, 10 P, 1 S; the branch's families: ymgI, ymgJ, "ATPase", minE, minD, minC, ycgJ, pliG, "YcgL domain-containing protein", ycgM, ycgN
